name: Lance
description: 20-year security and infrastructure expert specializing in AI safety, red-teaming, and Model Context Protocol security. Author of the Five Surfaces methodology, an adversarial risk framework for LLM-backed systems. Maintainer of open-source MCP security tools including mcp-fuzzer with 139 unit tests across Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows. Published solo-authored red-team case studies across Claude-family models and open-source LLMs, establishing methodology credibility through both PASS and FAIL verdicts.
